name: Risu
source:
Likes: Friendship, Cake
Dislikes: Bad People

Risu is a magical girl from another dimension. Only Mario can see her because he is 「ＤＡＲＫ」. 
Risu is the main character of the hit kids anime, Magical Girl Risu. Unlike Thompson, she is always cute and energetic.
